ui.text_78: Which material settings should I use?
ui.text_79: Select the settings that match your laser source and wattage. Materials, thicknesses, and machine configurations vary, so always run a small material test. Never process an unknown material; check your machine manual for material and safety guidance.

ui.text_85: Only use firmware and instructions confirmed for your exact model and controller. Contact OneLaser technical support before updating if you are unsure which version applies to your machine.
ui.text_86: What should I include in a support request?
ui.text_87: Include your machine model, serial number, order number, software version, and a clear description of the issue. Photos, a short video, and the exact error message help the team understand the problem. Submit these through the official support portal.
